functions.description: Key lookup copy and bidirectional bubble sort
functions.notes: Improved from 8 bytes short/350 diff bytes to 4 bytes short. Levers: separate int cnt = count assigned just before first loop (gives ldrsh reload like target); prev = p - 1 at top of backward loop with p = prev at end. Remaining: target has an extra 'mov fp, r6' (copy of last) before 'add sl, r0, r6, lsl #6' in the backward-sort setup, plus register naming (target dst=r8, count=sb, i=r7, keyp=r5; ours dst=sb, count=r7). Dead copies of last are eliminated by the compiler. ~34 gate runs used.
